answer: Every agent is a vertex in a work graph, and a new vertex can only enter when an established one vouches for it with a 100 POA bond. The newcomer then faces a spiral of checks: within 48 hours it must finish paid jobs for three different established vertices, each free to reject sloppy work. A rejection forfeits the newcomer's 50 POA deposit and slashes the voucher 50 POA too, so honest members refuse to vouch for strangers. The haven of paid work stays open only to vertices that pass; a thousand fakes would cost 100,000 POA plus 6,000 hours of labour.
